competences.description: Attacks the enemy 2 times to disturb the target's HP recovery for 2 turns with a 30% chance each.

effets.description: The target's HP cannot be recovered.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies 2 times to block them from receiving beneficial effects and to increase the chance of landing glancing hits for 2 turns with a 70% chance each. The damage increases according to the enemy's MAX HP.

effets.description: All beneficial effects will be blocked

The chance of landing a glancing hit will be increased by 50%. Glancing Hits will decrease the damage by 30% and if the attacker has attribute disadvantage, damage will be decreased additionally by 16%.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies and stuns for 1 turn if there are 4 or more enemies. The damage increases the higher the enemy's current HP. Attacks the selected target 6 times if there are 3 or fewer enemies and deals damage that ignores Defense up to 100% the lower the target's current HP.

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.
Attack will ignore the target's defense.
